verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public REST API that exchanges JSON over HTTPS. It publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec at api.attio.com/openapi/api covering objects, records, lists and webhooks, and offers per-endpoint 'Try it' playgrounds. Supporting guides cover filtering and sorting, rate limiting (429 with Retry-After), OAuth flows and webhooks. The probe 404s only checked docs-domain paths and do not contradict the spec served at its documented location. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world API usage.
